title:
Flats hitting 50:
*Your lease, your CPF*

lines.say: More HDB flats are crossing the 50 year mark. Buying one with 49 years left? Check your CPF first.
It comes down to one test: does the lease cover the youngest buyer until age 95?
With 49 years left, the youngest buyer needs to be 46 or older.
Younger than that? Your CPF use is cut in proportion, and so is your HDB loan.
Useful so far? Follow for more.
Less than 20 years left? No CPF at all.
Older flats can be cheaper for a reason. Check the lease against your age first.
Save this before your next viewing.

caption:
More HDB flats are crossing the 50 year mark. Buying one with 49 years left? Check your CPF first. 🏢

The test: does the remaining lease cover the youngest buyer until age 95? With 49 years left, the youngest buyer needs to be 46 or older. If not, your CPF use and HDB loan are cut in proportion. Less than 20 years left means no CPF at all.

Older flats can be cheaper for a reason. Check the lease against your age first.

Save this before your next viewing 👇
